protocol: Freeze both source-preserving Qwen projections and evaluate the same 1,360 articles under all five exact GLM recipes. Keep genuine quarter/top-four 10% ATLAS delta fixed at each pre-GLM projection. Report macro recall over 12 observed labels and over the 8 labels with >=20 examples and ordinary accuracy. Use 3,000 paired bootstrap draws within each observed source-model/generation-day/true-class stratum; also disclose that these are samples within a single publisher, not independent publishers. Aggregate per run date and source-class. Primary fixed and adaptive results are reported separately. No tuning, no new prediction candidate, no hidden-score inference.
scope: External component validation of dual Nishant Qwen, actual GLM selectors/heads, and optional ATLAS on a single public benchmark publisher. The 12 labels are publisher-reported proxy model names without independent provider receipts. 2 Terra rows; four sparse classes have <20. Full V30 upstream ensemble and hidden competition scores are unknown. V1/V3/V4/V7/V8/V9 use the fixed projection natively; their adaptive crossovers are synthetic component combinations. V6 is the adaptive-projection V3+ATLAS arm.
